name: Kavian Inspired by Al Haitham | Premium Arabic Unisex Perfume
description: Kavian, inspired by the luxurious Arabic perfume Al Haitham, is a powerful, deep, and captivating unisex fragrance crafted for lovers of rich oriental scents. It opens with a warm burst of saffron and citrus nuances, setting the stage for an opulent Middle Eastern aroma. As the scent unfolds, a sophisticated blend of rose, violet, and pure oud creates a smooth, smoky floral heart that feels both regal and exotic. The base is enriched with ambrox, ambrosinide, musk, sandalwood, natural oud wood, and pure Siofi oud oil—delivering remarkable depth, warmth, and long-lasting performance. With its premium perfume-oil concentration, Kavian offers impressive longevity and projection, making it perfect for winter evenings, special events, or anyone who appreciates bold Arabic fragrances. Elegant, intense, and unforgettable—Kavian brings the prestigious Al Haitham experience to Scents by Aamir. Features Top Notes: Saffron, Bergamot Heart Notes: Rose, Violet, Oud Base Notes: Ambrox, Ambrosinide, Musk, Sandalwood, Natural Oud Wood, Siofi Oud Oil Longevity: 10–12 hours (Very Long-Lasting) Occasion: Perfect for winter, special events, and evening wear Why Choose Kavian?
